ghi_chu: So lieu vong 3+4 (12/09/2026, ban da SUA sau khi phat hien loi cong chuyen). Ba ket qua quan trong nhat: (1) Power-MF DA CHAY LAI THAT qua Octave, va SAU KHI VA LOI CONG CHUYEN P7 moi cho so dung -- moi so Power-MF cong bo sang 12/09 DEU DA BI RUT; (2) Power-MF DON KENH da co, cho phep so sanh cung cau hinh dao trinh lan dau; (3) CinC 2013 danh gia DU 75 ban ghi thay vi 10 -> so chinh doi tu 69,31 len 79,40. Moi con so do that; truy nguoc duoc ve JSON tren dia.

A_powermf_DA_RUT_ban_cu.TRANG_THAI: DA RUT TOAN BO -- KHONG DUOC TRICH DAN NHU SU KIEN O BAT KY DAU
A_powermf_DA_RUT_ban_cu.ly_do_rut: Ban Power-MF dung de sinh cac so tren bi HONG tren 6 ban ghi Silesia B1 dai. Nguyen nhan: findpeaks cua goi signal trong Octave cai MinPeakDistance bang cach dung ma tran khoang cach doi mot O(k^2) -> tran bo nho tren B1 (2.395.600 mau sau noi suy x4). MATLAB -- nen tang cua tac gia -- dung thuat toan tham O(k log k) nen khong bao gio gap loi nay. Day la LOI CONG CHUYEN CUA NHOM, KHONG phai tinh chat cua Power-MF. Do do moi so sanh dua tren ban hong deu vo nghia.
A_powermf_DA_RUT_ban_cu.gia_thuyet_cu_da_bi_bac_bo: Gia thuyet 'ms_minpeakdistance = 340 ms qua sat' DA BI BAC BO bang do RR that tu nhan tham chieu: 0,00% khoang RR cua B1_01 duoi 340 ms (baselines/powermf_rr_diag.json). Khong co thay doi nao ve ms: moi lan chay van dung 340 ms mac dinh cua tac gia.
A_powermf_DA_RUT_ban_cu.cach_khac_phuc: baselines/octave/findpeaks_mpd.m -- tai lap dung ngu nghia MinPeakDistance cua MATLAB bang danh sach lien ket doi, O(k). Kiem chung 48/48 truong hop (baselines/octave/test_fpmpd.m).
A_powermf_DA_RUT_ban_cu.anh_huong: B1_01 tu 66,44 -> 99,92; B1_02 tu 67,12 -> 99,55; 4 ban ghi B1_03..B1_06 tu 'khong chay duoc' -> chay duoc.
